name: Enoch Apis
source:
The second auxiliary bishop of the Magic Department, and [url=https://vndb.org/c103278]Arne[/url]'s younger adopted brother. He's often seen at her side, while his affection towards her may seem stronger than a typical sibling bond... However, he wants the best for her, and constantly tries his best to be of help.

He additionally is a well-known figure in the temple thanks to his friendly and outgoing personality.
